title: SBA 7(a) and 504 loan-level data (FOIA files, data.sba.gov): approvals, guarantees, paid-in-full and charge-offs
agency: U.S. Small Business Administration, Office of Capital Access
questions: cumulative charge-off rate of SBA 7(a) loans by approval fiscal year (cohort), as a default assumption for a credit subsidy estimate
SBA 7(a) gross approvals and guaranteed amounts by fiscal year and state
how many 504 loans approved in FY2010-2015 were charged off, and the dollars charged off
SBA guaranteed lending by industry (NAICS) or processing method (SBA Express, Preferred Lenders)
average 7(a) loan size and guaranty share by fiscal year

manual.how: Open https://data.sba.gov/dataset/7a-504-foia in a browser, download the CSV file(s) named in INSTRUCTIONS.md (for example FOIA_7a_FY2020_Present_asof_260930.csv; the as-of date in the name changes each quarter) and upload them unchanged; --ingest filters them by the spec. The files are large (54 to 319 MB each).

cache.why: Each request streams one or more published CSVs (54 to 319 MB) to a temporary file and keeps only the asked rows or their totals; data/ is reused within a run only.

redistribution.why: SBA publishes these loan records under the Freedom of Information Act as U.S. government works in the public domain (17 U.S.C. 105); the status of active loans is withheld by SBA (FOIA Exemption 4). Cite SBA and the as-of date.

citation: U.S. Small Business Administration, {dataset}, data.sba.gov/dataset/7a-504-foia, retrieved {retrieved_long}.
clarify: Which program: 7(a) (lender loans with an SBA guaranty) or 504 (CDC debentures)? Default: 7(a), the larger one; 504 when the question names CDCs or real estate and equipment debentures.

Charge-off rate on what base: loans or dollars, and out of all approvals or only disbursed loans? Default: out of disbursed loans (approvals minus cancelled and undisbursed), by count and by gross approval dollars, cumulative to the file's as-of date.

use_instead.question: Credit subsidy rates, default assumptions and reestimates of SBA loan programs by cohort
use_instead.why: The Federal Credit Supplement of the President's Budget publishes them; the SBA files give realized loan outcomes.

use_instead.question: Federal loan and loan guarantee obligations and subsidy cost by agency or recipient
use_instead.why: USAspending reports face value and original subsidy cost of federal loans and guarantees; the SBA files give loan outcomes (paid in full, charged off) but no subsidy cost.
